name: Noesia Smart Waiter
author: noesiaswa

sections.description:
Noesia Matrix OS includes 6 professional operating layers:

  1. HoReCa & Hospitality OS
  2. Executive & Business Operations OS
  3. Clinical, Dental & Beauty OS
  4. Security, Identity & Private Data OS
  5. Creative, Media & Productivity OS
  6. Intelligence, World & Matrix Dashboard OS

38 integrated apps. One WordPress operating system.

A modular operating workspace for WordPress, built for restaurants, hotels, cafes, bars, clinics, agencies, private users, and modern businesses that want a faster, smarter, more visual, and more useful way to work online.

A ready-to-use mobile menu experience for Ho.Re.Ca. businesses. It gives each business a polished customer-facing interface with QR access, table call, bill request, payment support, color-blind friendly menu support, and custom fields such as Wi-Fi, music, Google rating, and more.

Architecture and Navigation Philosophy

  • CRM-style organization for daily workflows
  • Wizard-based setup
  • Event-driven architecture, isolated AJAX flows, IoC-oriented logic, and scalable modular structure
  • UI/UX designed for clarity, speed, and a cohesive daily workflow
  • X_Code modular thinking

See what Noesia Matrix OS can really do

To experience the full Noesia Matrix OS vision, explore cinematic app stories
https://noesia.io/noesia-matrix-os-app-stories/

Free Apps Inside the Noesia Matrix

  • Dashboard — The heart of Noesia. The Feel system is one of the core navigation ideas of the platform.

  • How to Use / Guided Onboarding

  • Docs / Documentation Hub — A central guide for setup.

  • Global Data Hub — A structured intelligence surface for official-style data visibility.

  • Global Pulse — A global-awareness layer that surfaces notable world days, relevant global signals, and live WordPress update context.

  • News — A built-in live news surface.

  • Weather — Practical weather visibility.

  • Image Tools — A powerful self-hosted image utility workspace for compression, comparison, resizing, conversion, and batch export.

  • Design — A creative support surface and elegant front-facing presentation workflows.

  • QR Setup — A guided QR workflow surface.

  • QR Generator — A practical QR generation utility.

  • Appointments — A lightweight scheduling and appointment flow.

  • Reminders — A clean follow-up and reminder surface for remembering what matters and keeping daily execution sharper.

  • Calculator & BMI — A fast utility layer for immediate calculations.

  • Preview App — A controlled preview surface for testing.

  • Screen Lock — A simple secure-lock layer for dashboard environments.

  • Project Synapse — Ask, reflect, and discover how major spiritual and philosophical traditions approach your questions, then use AETHER to privately release your thoughts, wishes, and inner messages.

  • Text & Dev Tools — A compact utility workspace.

  • Widgets — Modular dashboard widgets that extend the operating shell.

  • Settings — The control room for the Noesia ecosystem.

  • Unlock Boxes — A structured gateway into more expansion, discovery, and future ecosystem layers.

Pro Apps – Unlock the Noesia Matrix X_Code Experience

  • Live Command Pro — Faster service workflows by replacing traditional friction-heavy table workflows and even reducing dependency on classic POS-style handling, as guests can interact through QR code, open the live menu and move directly to WooCommerce-powered payment flows. Receipt sending, without paper, without complicated SMS logic, and with minimal or no direct contact friction. Ready-to-use shortcode menu and table-call panel.

  • Smart Pocket — A premium media center and personal vault environment that brings together music, music videos, radio, gallery items, voice clips, notes, pinned items, favorites, and acoustic control in one beautiful workspace.

  • Guardian — GPS and live coordination module, live location confidence, parking memory, map spots, QR activation, and admin-to-client chat. It is useful for businesses, families, field execution, and personal navigation convenience.

  • Auth Vault — Built as an ads-free, self-hosted, zero-knowledge style OTP vault with local unlock, local code generation, encrypted backup paths, pairing codes, and standalone PWA behavior.

  • AI Studio — The business AI workspace of Noesia.

  • Agents — A protected executive communication center for CEOs, directors, agencies, and collaborators.

  • Clinical Workspace — A reimagined digital medical workspace.

  • DentaVision AR — A modern dental and smile-communication surface for visual simulations and stronger treatment presentation.

  • ERP Lite — A structured ERP-style operational workspace.

  • Payroll — An enterprise-ready Payroll & Time Attendance framework.

  • CRM Lite — A customer and relationship workflow surface.

  • Email Marketing — A private in-platform email and outreach engine for templates, AI Writer, folders, campaign flow, and high-volume simulation testing.

  • SafeLog — Useful for technical routines, hospitality checks, room inspections, and disciplined reporting flows.

  • Tasks — A practical execution surface.

  • Noesia Vision — An advanced image-intelligence and OCR-oriented workspace. It helps transform images into usable operational information.

  • Vision Screening — A guided screening and acuity surface for structured operator-led visual assessment.

  • Mini SVN — A secure internal build vault for package intake, version history, archive logic, release notes, compare review, and disciplined internal app handling.

  • Noesia Screen Recorder — A protected recording and capture surface for creating controlled media records.

  • Screen Saver Pro — A built-in screen-saver layer that allows users to upload their own custom images or videos.

  • Hair AI Studio — A salon-focused AI consultation workspace that gives clients instant hairstyle previews.

Privacy and Compliance

Noesia is built for self-hosted WordPress environments. Site owners remain responsible for permissions, backups, local compliance, and production validation.

External services

Noesia Smart Waiter includes optional dashboard, weather, news, currency, global data, AI, optional download, and licensing features that may connect to external services. The plugin does not send restaurant orders, customer records, private uploaded files, clinical files, payroll files, or private business documents to these services.

The following external services may be contacted:

OpenAI API

Used by AI-related modules such as Project Synapse when an administrator adds their own OpenAI API key and submits a request. Data sent may include the submitted prompt/reflection text, selected scene/context, selected model setting, and relevant local knowledge-pack context. The plugin does not send WordPress passwords, payment data, uploaded media, or the site’s full database.

Service:
https://openai.com/

Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/

Privacy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Noesia.io optional downloads

Used when an administrator installs or updates optional Noesia-hosted packages. The plugin downloads package files from noesia.io and stores them locally in the WordPress uploads area. Standard HTTP request metadata may be processed by the server. The plugin does not send Synapse questions, OpenAI API keys, WordPress passwords, payment data, uploaded media, or the site’s full database to noesia.io for this download.

This plugin bundles third-party minified assets for production use. Human-readable source code is available from the original upstream projects below.

  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/WMFJS.bundle.min.js — WMFJS — https://github.com/tbluemel/rtf.js
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/RTFJS.bundle.min.js — RTFJS — https://github.com/tbluemel/rtf.js
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/heic2any.min.js — heic2any — https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any

  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/pako.min.js — pako — https://github.com/nodeca/pako
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/pdf.min.js — PDF.js 5.6.205 module build, loaded through a local compatibility bridge — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/pdf.worker.min.js — PDF.js 5.6.205 worker module build — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/noesia-pdfjs-bridge.js — Local compatibility bridge for PDF.js module loading — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/purify.min.js — DOMPurify — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/xlsx.full.min.js — SheetJS / xlsx 0.20.3 — https://git.sheetjs.com/sheetjs/sheetjs
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/jsquash-avif/codec/enc/avif_enc.wasm — jSquash AVIF WebAssembly encoder runtime — https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash
  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/jsquash-webp/codec/enc/webp_enc.wasm — jSquash WebP WebAssembly encoder runtime — https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash

Bundled runtime files and third-party sources

Project Synapse Knowledge Pack source note

The optional Project Synapse Knowledge Pack may include or reference public-domain or license-noted source material, including Project Gutenberg texts. Project Gutenberg is not contacted at runtime during normal Synapse use.

Project Gutenberg license:
https://www.gutenberg.org/policy/license.html

Project Gutenberg terms:
https://www.gutenberg.org/policy/terms_of_use.html

Image Tools WebAssembly codec runtime files

Noesia Smart Waiter includes the following WebAssembly runtime codec files for the Image Tools module:

  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/jsquash-avif/codec/enc/avif_enc.wasm and /jsquash-webp/codec/enc/webp_enc.wasm

These files are required runtime assets for local browser-side image conversion and encoding. They are used to encode AVIF and WebP images directly in the user’s browser as part of the Image Tools module.

They are not development files, build artifacts, logs, backups, private files, or server-side executables. They are local WebAssembly codec binaries loaded by the bundled Image Tools encoder scripts when the user performs image conversion.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/noesia-smart-waiter/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Noesia Dashboard.
  4. Run the Wizard and choose your preferred interface direction, menu style, and initial setup flow.
  5. Explore the free apps and unlock Pro when you are ready to expand into the full Noesia Matrix X_Code experience.
sections.faq:
Is the free version useful on its own?

Yes. The free version already delivers the Noesia dashboard, the Feel-driven navigation experience, the Wizard setup flow, and a meaningful group of free apps.

Where can I watch the Noesia Matrix OS product worlds and video experiences?

You can explore the Noesia Matrix OS through cinematic product worlds, each focused on a different part of everyday life, professional work, and business operations.

Each video experience presents a different Noesia app, profession, or workflow, showing how the system can support personal media, clinical experiences, salons, HoReCa operations, business tools, and more.

Current video experiences include:

  • Smart Pocket – your personal media center for music, voice recordings, images, notes, playlists, music videos, world radio, uploads, favorites, and pins.
  • DentaVision AR – a dental experience for smile simulation, QR patient access, and clinic pricing.
  • Hair AI Studio – a salon and barber experience for hairstyle previews.
  • Live Command / HoReCa – an operational command experience for restaurants, cafes, hotels, and service teams.

sections.changelog:
2.0.6

Release: May 2026

Noesia Matrix OS v2.0.6
* Added Project Synapse to the free human layer of Noesia Matrix OS, including Ask Synapse, faith and philosophy scenes, source-grounded reflection, OpenAI-powered responses, and AETHER private release mode.
* Added dedicated Project Synapse scenes for Ask Synapse, Christianity, Stoicism, Buddhism, Islam, Hinduism, Taoism, and AETHER.
* Added Synapse Knowledge Pack installation flow for local source-oriented context inside the WordPress uploads area.
* Added OpenAI API key and model selection settings for Project Synapse.
* Added AETHER as a non-storage symbolic release surface where private words can be written, released, and visually dissolved.
* Added Agents to the Executive & Business layer as a protected communication control center for CEOs, agencies, directors, organizations, and collaborators.
* Added protected Agent portals with portal password access for external collaborators.
* Added structured Agent messages, admin replies, manual sync tools, and a centered conversation panel.
* Added protected file handling and controlled download flow for Agent portal uploads.
* Added Active, Resolved, and Archived communication states for Agents.
* Added email notifications for protected Agent activity. Notifications are lightweight notices and do not send private files as email attachments.
* Upgraded the Setup Wizard with clearer professional workspaces and operating layers.
* Improved Free / Pro locked preview behavior in the Setup Wizard so Pro modules can appear as locked previews without creating fake switch states or hidden menu values.
* Applied Smart Pocket stability improvements for the personal media, notes, files, music, photos, and video workspace.
* Added dedicated Matrix documentation pages for Project Synapse and Agents.
* Moved the changelog stream into a dedicated Noesia Matrix OS X_Code Changelog page.
* Updated public Matrix positioning to present 34 mapped applications plus 4 already-included extra experiences: Screen Saver Pro, Hair AI Studio, Project Synapse, and Agents.
* Updated roadmap and unlock-box presentation so Project Synapse and Agents appear as already included instead of coming soon.
* Applied general stability, wording, presentation, and micro-polish refinements across the current production branch.

Full changelog:
https://noesia.io/noesia-matrix-os-x_code-changelog/

Privacy and Compliance

Noesia is built for self-hosted WordPress environments. Site owners remain responsible for permissions, backups, local compliance, and production validation.

External services

Noesia Smart Waiter includes optional dashboard, weather, news, currency, global data, AI, optional download, and licensing features that may connect to external services. The plugin does not send restaurant orders, customer records, private uploaded files, clinical files, payroll files, or private business documents to these services.

Image Tools WebAssembly codec runtime files

Noesia Smart Waiter includes the following WebAssembly runtime codec files for the Image Tools module:

  • modules/free/image-tools/assets/vendor/jsquash-avif/codec/enc/avif_enc.wasm and /jsquash-webp/codec/enc/webp_enc.wasm

These files are required runtime assets for local browser-side image conversion and encoding. They are used to encode AVIF and WebP images directly in the user’s browser as part of the Image Tools module.

They are not development files, build artifacts, logs, backups, private files, or server-side executables. They are local WebAssembly codec binaries loaded by the bundled Image Tools encoder scripts when the user performs image conversion.
